sentences.text: Gwalior Bench: Dated 16/10/2020
Shri M.K.Chaudhary and Shri V.K.Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri K.K.Prajapati, learned Panel lawyer for the respondent/State.
Matter is heard through Video Conferencing.
The applicant has filed this fifth bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 3.9.2019 by Police Station, Jaura,
District Morena, in connection with Crime No.504/2019 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273 of IPC and Sections 51 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Except fourth application, all applications have been dismissed as withdrawn.

It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 3.9.2019 and more than 13 months have passed in confinement and now he learnt the lesson hard way and would mend his ways and would become a better citizen by becoming a law abiding citizen.
Looking to the period of custody as well as the fact that some of the witnesses have been examined,
his case for bail be considered.

He undertakes to cooperate in trial and further undertakes to perform community service and to serve environmental/national/social cause HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Gyani Sharma Vs. State of M.P. ) voluntarily to purge his misdeeds, if any.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Gyani Sharma Vs. State of M.P. )
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On behalf of the applicant, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he intends to serve the cause of advocates who are in financial distress by making contribution in the funds of High Court Bar Association, Gwalior, on his own volition.

On these premises, he prayed for bail Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and submits that applicant was accused of providing adulterated items and allegations against him are having wider ramifications.
Heard learned counsel for the parties at length through VC and considered the arguments advanced by them.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as the period of custody which is more than 13 months and the fact that early conclusion of trial is a bleak possibility in Covid-19 pandemic situation as well as the fact that some of the prosecution witnesses have been Gyani Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 October, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77199155/
1 examined, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

sentences.text: In view of COVID-19 pandemic, the jail authorities are directed that before releasing the applicant, his preliminary Corona Virus test shall be conducted and if he is found positive then the applicant shall be immediately sent to concerned hospital for his treatment as per medical norms but if he is found negative, then he shall be released.
After his release, the applicant is further directed to strictly follow all the instructions which may be issued by the Central Govt./State Govt. or Local Administration for combating the Covid19.
